description: Pre-existing local dignity classification sites. Stream B (B-01) migrates each to brahmagyan.dignity_oracle. Remove entries as B-01 PRs land.

entries.justification: Pre-existing local dignity lookup in l1_strength; B-01 stream will evaluate migration path.

F-62 (VERIFIER Stage R deficiency 3): the module-level DIGNITY_TABLE dict is now dead code for classification purposes -- _compute_dignity delegates to brahmagyan.dignity_oracle.classify_dignity() -- but the dict itself is kept as pure data for _build_saptavargaja_rows' own-sign lookup (own-sign membership needs no degree gate; see that function's inline comment). Pinned to a content pattern (the dict's opening Sun entry) rather than a line number: an exact-line allowlist entry silently breaks the moment any earlier line in the file changes (this is exactly what happened when F-62's own import line shifted the dict from line 134 to 135), flipping D-01b from PASS to FAIL for zero new content. A content pattern survives that class of drift.
